title: Toggle a supplier import parameter's visibility
summary: Toggles the Visible flag of a supplier import parameter in the IntegratedLibrary options with IOptionsReader and IOptionsWriter, and reports what ISupplierManager returns for it; a second command lists both views.
phrasings: change a stored preference of an Altium Designer server
read and write options with the options manager
make an imported supplier parameter visible

commands.name: SupplierPreference
commands.description: Toggle the Visible flag of a supplier import parameter (append it visible when missing), flush, and report the options and supplier manager values

commands.name: ListSupplierImportParameters
commands.description: List the supplier import parameters from the options store and from ISupplierManager
